name: todo-planner
description: Create, update and delete Microsoft To Do and Microsoft Planner tasks, lists and plans from Claude.
long_description:
Manage your **Microsoft To Do** lists and tasks and **Microsoft Planner** plans, buckets and tasks through Microsoft Graph, as the signed-in Microsoft 365 user.

**Sign-in:** after installing, ask Claude *"Log in to To Do"* and choose either your organisation's own Entra app registration or the Microsoft-published *Microsoft Graph Command Line Tools* app. Your browser opens for Microsoft sign-in and MFA. No passwords or secrets are stored; tokens are cached per user, encrypted with Windows DPAPI. If the session expires, the sign-in window opens automatically.

**Time zone** is detected from your Microsoft 365 settings (or this computer).

**Requires** [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on this computer; it installs Python and the dependencies automatically on first start.

Example prompts:
- To Do: 'Show my To Do lists' | 'Create a To Do list called Client Onboarding' | 'Add a task Renew SSL certificate to my Tasks list, due Friday, high importance' | 'What's still open in my Work list?' | 'Mark Renew SSL certificate as completed' | 'Add checklist steps to that task: backup, renew, verify' | 'Move it to the Admin list' | 'Delete the Old ideas list'
- Planner: 'Show my Planner tasks' | 'List my plans' | 'Create a plan M365 Migration in the IT Projects group with buckets Discovery, Build, Cutover' | 'Add a task Licensing audit to M365 Migration in Discovery, assign to me, due 2026-11-01, priority important' | 'Move Licensing audit to Build and set it in progress' | 'Rename the Cutover bucket to Go-live'
- Account: 'Check my To Do sign-in status' | 'Log in to To Do' | 'Turn off automatic sign-in'

tools.name: planner_list_my_groups
tools.description: List Microsoft 365 groups the user belongs to (needed as the container when creating a plan).

tools.name: planner_list_plans
tools.description: List Planner plans (projects) shared with the signed-in user, with their group IDs.

tools.name: planner_create_plan
tools.description: Create a Planner plan (project) in a Microsoft 365 group, optionally with initial buckets

tools.name: planner_rename_plan
tools.description: Rename a Planner plan. plan_ref is the plan ID or exact title.

tools.name: planner_delete_plan
tools.description: Permanently delete a Planner plan with ALL its buckets and tasks. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: planner_list_buckets
tools.description: List buckets (columns) in a Planner plan.

tools.name: planner_create_bucket
tools.description: Create a bucket in a Planner plan.

tools.name: planner_rename_bucket
tools.description: Rename a bucket in a Planner plan.

tools.name: planner_delete_bucket
tools.description: Permanently delete a bucket and ALL tasks in it. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: planner_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a Planner plan, optionally filtered by bucket, completion and assignment.

tools.name: planner_my_tasks
tools.description: List Planner tasks assigned to the signed-in user across all plans.

tools.name: planner_get_task
tools.description: Get a Planner task including description and checklist.

tools.name: planner_create_task
tools.description: Create a Planner task. assignees: 'me', user object IDs, or emails. labels: label names

tools.name: planner_update_task
tools.description: Update a Planner task. Only supplied fields change. Empty string for due/start clears it.

tools.name: planner_delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a Planner task. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: todo_list_lists
tools.description: List all Microsoft To Do task lists (projects) for the signed-in user.

tools.name: todo_create_list
tools.description: Create a new Microsoft To Do task list (project).

tools.name: todo_rename_list
tools.description: Rename a To Do list. list_ref is the list ID or its exact name.

tools.name: todo_delete_list
tools.description: Permanently delete a To Do list AND all tasks in it. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: todo_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a To Do list. list_ref is the list ID or exact name (e.g. 'Tasks').

tools.name: todo_get_task
tools.description: Get one To Do task with notes and checklist items.

tools.name: todo_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a To Do list. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (local time).

tools.name: todo_update_task
tools.description: Update a To Do task. Only supplied fields change. Pass an empty string for a date to clear it.

tools.name: todo_delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a To Do task. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: todo_move_task
tools.description: Move a task to another To Do list (copies title, notes, dates, importance, status,

tools.name: todo_add_checklist_item
tools.description: Add a checklist (sub-step) item to a To Do task.

tools.name: todo_update_checklist_item
tools.description: Rename and/or tick/untick a checklist item on a To Do task.

tools.name: todo_delete_checklist_item
tools.description: Delete a checklist item from a To Do task. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show which sign-in app and Microsoft 365 account are in use and whether a valid token is available.

tools.name: auto_login
tools.description: Turn automatic sign-in on or off. When on (default), an expired Microsoft 365 session

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Microsoft 365. Opens the system browser on this computer for sign-in/MFA.

client_id.title: Own app registration client ID (optional)
client_id.description: Leave blank to choose at sign-in. Set it to force your organisation's own Entra app (option 1) for everyone using this install. Not a secret.

tenant.title: Tenant ID or domain (optional)
tenant.description: Restricts sign-in to your tenant, e.g. contoso.com.au. Recommended if you also have accounts in customer tenants. Leave blank to use the value chosen at sign-in.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: 'auto' detects it from Microsoft 365 (then Windows). Or an IANA zone such as Australia/Sydney.

auto_login.title: Open sign-in automatically when the session expires
auto_login.description: Opens the Microsoft sign-in page in your browser when needed; the request then continues.

extra_scopes.title: Extra Graph permissions (optional)
extra_scopes.description: Space-separated, e.g. 'GroupMember.Read.All User.ReadBasic.All' to list groups and assign tasks by email. Sign in again after changing.
